REST v1 protected reporting reads: GET /api/v1/attendance/current, GET /api/v1/employees/{employee_id}/attendance-summary, GET /api/v1/employees/{employee_id}/attendance-analysis, GET /api/v1/attendance/organization-analysis, and GET /api/v1/attendance/exceptions; delegated bearer and UUID correlation required; existing authorization, bounded date-range/pagination, result serialization, safe errors, and correlation-linked audits preserved

REST v1 workforce status: GET /api/v1/attendance/current remains available to delegated authenticated employees; omitted as_of uses server Europe/Ljubljana local time, accepts only office, remote, customer_site, break, absence, or no_status filters, omits unknown states before pagination, and preserves correlation-linked safe audits

REST v1 privileged employee resolver: GET /api/v1/employees/resolve?employee_id=&username=&email= is registered before the employee-id route; administrators must supply exactly one exact identifier and receive a directory-safe EmployeeSummary or safe INVALID_ARGUMENT, NOT_FOUND, or FORBIDDEN with correlation-linked auditing

MCP tool lifecycle instrumentation: every registered tool invocation emits safe start and step events followed by one success or failure event with tool handler identity, correlation ID, monotonic duration, empty sanitized inputs, and a stable safe error code when known; durable audit records and client-facing MCP errors remain unchanged
